title: Open research problem (Problem Schema v1.0)
description: A source-grounded, currently open, independently reviewable research problem, following docs/problem-schema-v1.0.md plus the minimal pipeline fields (status, domain, topic_id, repository).

parent_problem_id.description: Direct parent problem; null when the problem has no parent.

abstract.description: A short overview of the problem.

background.description: Background, definitions, and known results needed to understand the problem.

previous_progress.description: Progress already made on this problem.

problem_statement.description: The complete, precise, self-contained problem statement.

scientific_significance.description: The affected field, the significance level, and specifically what would change. No single aggregate score.

level.description: high: solving it directly changes the field's core knowledge, methods, or capabilities; medium: clear progress or substantive momentum for follow-up work; low: local, indirect, or incremental impact.

solution_difficulty.description: Possible solution difficulties, listed without scores.

verification_contract.description: Acceptance contracts keyed by answer type; the keys are the admissible answer types, so there is no separate expected-answer-type field. Null only when a parent problem has delegated solving and acceptance to its subproblems.

contract.description: What an answer of this type must submit and what the reviewer checks to pass or fail it.

ci_contract.description: The part of the contract executable by CI; null when no reasonable automated acceptance exists.

verification_difficulty.description: Overall acceptance difficulty for the whole problem (not per answer type): the residual Agent or human reviewer judgment after every mechanically checkable part is excluded. Not a publication threshold. Null only for a parent problem that delegated to subproblems.

status.description: Pipeline lifecycle state: open after an open-current audit, ready once compiled into its solution repository, uncertain when the audit evidence was inconclusive, resolved-externally or refuted-externally when later literature settled the problem.

topic_id.description: Grouping metadata: the configured campaign topic this problem was selected under.

kind.description: solution is the one-problem repository layout.
